sample.description: NASDAQ-100 constituents from Wikipedia oldid 1257470804 as of 2024-11-15 (101 securities incl. GOOG+GOOGL =100 companies) matching paper Appendix tables. Retrieved 101 tickers, 98 with price data via market_data.get_prices for 2020-01-01 to 2024-11-20; 3 unavailable (delisted). Fully connected empirical correlation graph with edge weight w=sqrt(2(1-C)). Returns: log returns on adj_close, daily frequency, pairwise-complete overlap (min 30 days). No MST pruning.

not_rebuilt.postflow_edge_weight_3: Observed flat-link weight ~3 after 20 Ricci-flow iterations (zero-curvature neckpinch). Requires full iterative Ricci flow: at each of 20 steps solve Wasserstein LP for every edge (~~4750 edges x 20 = ~95k HiGHS LPs) and update w^{(l+1)}=(1-kappa^{(l)}) d^{(l)}; computationally heavy and surgery calibration on zero-curvature threshold not fully specified. Uniform mass definition in Appendix yields constant kappa=(1-alpha)n/(n-1) when d=w, so degenerate and flow does not separate; paper's observed spread implies unspecified strength-weighted mass or shortest-path violations. Not rebuilt from data.

sample.substitutions: Universe from Wikipedia Nasdaq-100 old revision 2024-11-15 (revid1257470804) HTML table 101 securities (Table 4, 102 rows inc header) which exactly matches all tickers in paper Appendix tables (101 vs paper claimed 100). Price source: market_data.get_prices cache first then yfinance live (adj_close). Returns: log returns (paper does not state simple vs log or price column; standard choice log on adj_close, daily frequency, mean/std over window, pairwise complete for short-history IPOs like ARM 300 days, GEHC 486 days, GFS 771 days, CEG 715 days). Correlation Pearson as defined. Edge weight w sqrt(2(1-C)). Curvature sampling uses uniform mass (1-alpha)/(n-1) with alpha=0.5 and Floyd-Warshall shortest path; full distribution not computed due to unspecified solver weighting (uniform vs strength-weighted masses) and computational cost; theoretical values (kappa_complete 0.505, bounds -2/1, kappa_min -1.96, edge length 2.96) computed via formulas.

notes: Choices: 1) Universe retrieval date unspecified in paper; retrieved Nasdaq-100 as of 2024-11-15 (last revision before period end 2024-11-20) via Wikipedia API oldid 1257470804; this yields 101 securities (100 companies) exactly matching all Appendix tickers (verified vs paper tables: ARM, GEHC, GFS etc.) - paper states N=100 but Appendix sums to 101 (GOOG+GOOGL double). 2) Price column: paper says Yahoo Finance prices not stating adjusted vs close; used adj_close (standard for total return, adjusts splits/dividends) with log returns r_t=log(P_t/P_{t-1}) daily; paper leaves open daily vs other frequency, simple vs log - standard choice. 3) Handling missing/short-history tickers: ARM (IPO 2023-09-14, 300 days), GFS (271 days overlap? actually 771 days from 2021), GEHC (486), CEG (715) - used pairwise-complete overlap with min 30 days vs common intersection which would truncate to 300 days; this preserves 98 tickers. 4) Missing tickers ANSS, EA, WBD unavailable via yfinance (ANSS delisted post Synopsys acquisition mid-2025, EA/WBD data gaps per host) - counted as missing=3, see market_data_requests.json. 5) Shortest path d(i,j): for complete graph direct w is shortest if triangle inequality holds; computed Floyd-Warshall to verify and detect  violations; paper not stating exact transport solver (ni2019community GitHub referenced but commit not given); used dual LP via scipy linprog HiGHS for sample edges; uniform mass definition per Appendix (alpha on self + (1-alpha)/(n-1) uniformly to neighbors) yields constant curvature (1-alpha)n/(n-1)=0.505 for n=100 independent of w heterogeneity under direct distances, so histogram spread in paper implies either triangle violations causing d<w or weighted masses (by strength/affinity) - not specified. 6) Ricci flow update w^{(l+1)}=(1-kappa^{(l)}) d^{(l)} not iterated fully due to O(100k) LPs (~5 min per iteration) and surgery threshold calibration unspecified beyond zero-curvature flat links ~3; results for postflow_edge_weight_3 omitted per integrity rule (not computed from flow, now in not_rebuilt). 7) Deviations: average correlation computed 0.3799 -> 37.99% (paper 38%). Average/median edge weight derived from w sqrt(2(1-C)). Slight differences expected due to vendor (yfinance adj_close vs paper unspecified Yahoo field), delisted tickers, and correlation pairwise method. 8) Tallies for hierarchical clustering (Level1 66/35 etc) not rebuilt - require recursive Ricci flow + surgery algorithm with unspecified implementation details; listed in not_rebuilt.
